title: School Nutrition Services Meal Account — Effective Dates of Meal Status Changes and the Adverse Action Notice Period
content:
## Rule

(a) A new or higher status takes effect on its determination date, and an approval letter is sent the same day; a direct certification match or a categorical designation takes effect on the date it is recorded.

(b) A carryover status lasts through the last carryover operating day; when no current-year determination has replaced it by then, the account reverts to the carryover expiry status the next day with the decrease reason carryover expired, and no adverse action notice is needed for that reversion.

(c) A reduction or termination after verification takes effect only when it is no earlier than the adverse action notice period after the district sends the adverse action notice, counted in calendar days with the notice date as day 0; until then the student keeps the current status.

(d) A new household application that determines a lower status than the student currently holds from a source that has not ended (for example a reduced-price application while a direct certification is in force) does not lower the status.

(e) A household that submits a new application after a reduction is determined again as a new application, and a higher status from it takes effect on its determination date.

These rules apply to the School Nutrition Services Meal Account of every student; the adverse action notice period (10 calendar days), the last carryover operating day (2026-09-23) and the carryover expiry status (Paid Meal Status) are those in the schedules of meal statuses and verification.

## The notice-period clock

- **Clock starts:** the date the district sends the adverse action notice, as recorded in the account's notice history (an adverse action notice and its notice date). That record, not a household's recollection, sets day 0.
- **Counting:** calendar days, the notice date being day 0.
- **Comparison:** the reduction's effective day must be no earlier than day 10; day 10 itself satisfies it.
- **Until then:** the student keeps the current status.

| Hypothetical notice date (day 0) | Proposed effective day | Allowed? |
|---|---|---|
| a Thursday | the Sunday ten days later (day 10) | yes, the boundary day counts |
| a Thursday | the Saturday nine days later (day 9) | no; the current status stays |

## Carryover reversion (hypothetical)

A student holding Free Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) with no new determination keeps it through 2026-09-23 and reverts to Paid Meal Status on 2026-09-24, without an adverse action notice.
